title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode4 My Role Model

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What's Yuka Kazamatsuri doing in a place like this...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I really want to talk to her but... What should I do?! I'd hate to interrupt if she's in the middle of practice or something...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Geez... I'm so nervous, I'm getting drenched in sweat...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Again, can I help you?
You've been staring at me for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...!
I... Uh, th-that is...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I like your outfit. It's very cute.
You look just like a mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I, um...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was so busy cleaning up that I forgot to take this thing off...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Wait, it sounded like somebody was putting on some kind of performance just now too... Were you by chance a part of that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes! Yes, I was!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, uh... I work as a cast member for an amusement park called Phoenix Wonderland, and my troupe performed here today as its ambassadors...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You're a cast member for an amusement park? That must be quite a bit of fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
But more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you doing in a place like this, Ms. Kazamatsuri? I thought you weren't supposed to return to Japan until much later...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, you know who I am?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course!
I... I've been a huge fan since I was little...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You are? Really?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I never imagined that I'd meet one of my fans way out here.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I was actually just practicing for my performance for that return to Japan you just mentioned, and staying here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize that...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I promise to go and see your show!
I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
Good luck to you too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe that I'm talking to you right now, Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just that... You're the reason I decided to try to become an actress, Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Because of me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes! My dream is to become an actress who can touch people's hearts by singing just like you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your performance in the Little Mermaid ten years ago is still one of my absolute favorites!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
The Little Mermaid from ten years ago?!
Hehe. That really takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That was actually the first time I landed the lead for a show. I managed to win the part but still didn't have much experience.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But really I'm glad that you liked my performance so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really did! I joined a children's theatre group right after that to learn how to sing like you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There were some points where I felt like giving up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But now, I'm doing shows at one of the stages in Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Hehe. It's almost as if us meeting like this isn't just a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: By the way, how long are you here for?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Us? Well, we're here for three days, so until the day after tomorrow, and we're doing two shows each day at 11 am and 4 pm.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Then I might just be able to catch your last performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Do I need to buy tickets for your show?
If so, I'd like to buy some right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-N-No, that won't be necessary!
It's free to begin with and making you go out of your way to buy tickets doesn't seem right...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Oh, then I should be able to head straight over after I'm done practicing. By the way, your name is...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-Nene!
My name is Nene Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to your show, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Neneee! Where are you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Ah, that must be your friends.
Break a leg tomorrow, okay?
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we'll do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aha, there you are!!
Nene, I just finished cleaning up so I decided to come and get you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do, Emu...?!
She's coming to see our last show...!! What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-W-Wah?!
N-Nene, please! Try to calm down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You actually talked to her?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, they say truth is stranger than fiction.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene, that's so amazing.
What did you talk about?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I told her that I've been a big fan since she performed as the Little Mermaid and how we'll be doing our show for a couple more days.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's coming to see our show, right♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No way!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes way... She said she'll try to catch our last performance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, that's great!
What an incredible opportunity! We get to perform for your hero!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Our show's going to make her smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!! It's gonna be super duper maximum wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's do a quick debrief to make sure tomorrow goes even better than today! I'm sure we all found some things challenging being away from home like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I believe we can make the final scene more dramatic by having a slightly stronger fan creating wind for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna make a bigger splash with everyone during the last dance scene too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can always count on the three of them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They were willing to go with my idea, so I need to keep doing everything I can for them too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want more people to come and visit our park. I want the audience and Ms. Kazamatsuri to smile and laugh. As ambassadors...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's do our absolute best...!
